The vendor directly providing **Uptime Robot** at the domain **uptimerobot.com** is **UptimeRobot s. r. o.**

### Evidence
* **Terms of Service** (`uptimerobot.com/terms`):  
  > *"The following terms and conditions govern all use of the UptimeRobot products (Web App and iOS/Android mobile apps) and all content, services and products available at or through the website or mobile apps. The products are owned and operated by UptimeRobot s. r. o. ('UptimeRobot' -a trademark of the company-)."*

* **Privacy Policy** (`uptimerobot.com/privacy`):  
  > *"UptimeRobot (a service by UptimeRobot s. r. o.) operates several websites including uptimerobot.com, uptimerobot.com/api/ and uptimerobot.com/blog/."*
